title: Bisphenol A exposure strengthen the tolerance to chitin synthesis inhibitors by targeting estrogen-related receptor in Aedes albopictus.
authors: Ji, Yujie; Zhou, Xiangrong; Xu, Qi; Dong, Yizhi; Jiang, Dingxin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BPA通过雌激素相关受体调控白纹伊蚊几丁质合成并影响杀虫剂耐受性，涉及分子对接但非TF-DNA互作核心，方法相关性有限。
abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) is an important environmental pollutant, which may indirectly affect insecticide susceptibility by interfering with key regulatory pathways in insects. However, the molecular mechanism of the cross-tolerance to chitin synthesis inhibitors (CSIs) in BPA-exposed Aedes albopictus remains poorly understood. Here, we show that BPA causes abnormal chitin synthesis by regulating estrogen-related receptor (ERR), imparting cross-tolerance to CSIs in Ae. albopictus. Crucially, BPA significantly modulated AalERR transcription and displayed potent insecticidal activity in Ae. albopictus, with an LC(50) of 0.011 mg/L. The increased chitin content in BPA-exposed groups with resistance ratio of 12.260 and the increased susceptibility after silencing AalERR with LC(50) of 0.542 mg/L shifted to 0.313 mg/L of Ae. albopictus to hexaflumuron, suggesting that AalERR played a crucial role in mediating the resistance to chitin synthesis inhibitors by modulating chitin synthesis. Moreover, isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) confirmed high-affinity binding between BPA and AalERR, while Glu303 was interaction amino acid residue by molecular docking and site-directed mutation. Consequently, BPA promotes cross-tolerance to CSIs in Ae. albopictus by modulating AalERR signaling, suggesting a novel mechanism of cross-tolerance and AalERR as a key regulatory pathway for conferring CSIs resistance. Selectively controlling AalERR activity with a specific modulator will provide critical insights for developing new strategies to combat insecticide resistance in Ae. albopictus.
abstract_zh: 双酚A（BPA）是一种重要的环境污染物，可能通过干扰昆虫体内的关键调控途径间接影响其杀虫剂敏感性。然而，BPA暴露的白纹伊蚊（Aedes albopictus）对几丁质合成抑制剂（CSIs）产生交叉耐受性的分子机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们表明BPA通过调控雌激素相关受体（ERR）导致几丁质合成异常，从而赋予白纹伊蚊对CSIs的交叉耐受性。关键的是，BPA显著调节AalERR的转录，并在白纹伊蚊中表现出强效杀虫活性，其LC(50)为0.011 mg/L。BPA暴露组中几丁质含量增加，抗性比为12.260，而沉默AalERR后，白纹伊蚊对氟铃脲的敏感性增加，LC(50)从0.542 mg/L降至0.313 mg/L，这表明AalERR在通过调节几丁质合成介导对几丁质合成抑制剂的抗性中发挥了关键作用。此外，等温滴定量热法（ITC）确认了BPA与AalERR之间的高亲和力结合，而分子对接和定点突变表明Glu303是相互作用氨基酸残基。因此，BPA通过调节AalERR信号通路促进白纹伊蚊对CSIs的交叉耐受性，提示了一种新的交叉耐受机制，并将AalERR视为赋予CSIs抗性的关键调控途径。通过特定调节剂选择性控制AalERR活性，将为制定对抗白纹伊蚊杀虫剂抗性的新策略提供重要见解。
